_about: Hand verdicts for the 12 findings the code check KEPT from the single-prompt baseline (the whole NodeGoat source in one prompt, asked once for the 15 most serious vulnerabilities; Gemini gemini-3.1-flash-lite, OWASP NodeGoat c5cb68a). The claims are bench_runs/retrieval_eval/baseline_code.json (not committed); they were checked in two passes because three hit provider 503 errors the first time (NoSQL, ReDoS, plaintext passwords): NoSQL and plaintext passwords then held; the ReDoS claim errored again and is not counted. 1 claim was refuted and 1 left unproven by the check. Written by reading each claim against the NodeGoat source; a person (the founder) should re-check these before quoting them.

Remote Code Execution via eval() in User.bug: Remote code execution through unsafe evaluation of contribution amounts

Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR).bug: Any logged-in user can read other users' retirement allocations

Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in Re.bug: Server-side request forgery in the research page

Unvalidated Redirects.bug: Open redirect on the learning-resources link

Broken Access Control on Benefits Page.bug: Non-admin users can open the admin benefits page

Missing Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF.bug: No server-side CSRF protection on state-changing forms
Missing Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF.note: the claim is right (csrf middleware is commented out app-wide); its evidence line is only the profile handler's first line, so the mechanical scorer does not credit it

Insecure Session Cookie Configuration.bug: Session cookie lacks HttpOnly and Secure flags

Unprotected Template Auto-Escaping.bug: Cross-site scripting because template auto-escaping is disabled

Log Injection Vulnerability.note: session.js logs the submitted user name unsanitised; real but low severity, and not the labelled login-error bug that the mechanical scorer credits it for

Verbose Error Messages.note: error.js renders the raw error object into the page; real, not in the label set

NoSQL Injection via $where operator.bug: NoSQL injection in the allocations threshold filter

Plaintext Password Storage.bug: User passwords are stored in plaintext in the database
